# libabigail suppression rules for the ABI compatibility workflow.
#
# Replacing four private GL-context SbHash members with SbSmallMap stops the
# compiler from emitting their destructors. Suppress only those exact Itanium
# ABI symbols instead of all SbHash instantiations.

[suppress_function]
  symbol_name_regexp = ^_ZN6SbHashIjP16SoGLShaderObjectED[12]Ev$
  label = Private SoGLShaderObject context-map destructor replaced by SbSmallMap; it is not part of Coin's public ABI.

[suppress_function]
  symbol_name_regexp = ^_ZN6SbHashIjmED[12]Ev$
  label = Private shader program-handle context-map destructor replaced by SbSmallMap; it is not part of Coin's public ABI.

[suppress_function]
  symbol_name_regexp = ^_ZN6SbHashIjjED[12]Ev$
  label = Private uniform-parameter context-map destructor replaced by SbSmallMap; it is not part of Coin's public ABI.

# SoUniformShaderParameterP is defined only inside
# src/shaders/SoShaderParameter.cpp. Changing its private map member can alter
# whether its out-of-line destructor is emitted, but clients cannot name or use
# the class.

[suppress_function]
  symbol_name_regexp = ^_ZN25SoUniformShaderParameterPD[12]Ev$
  label = SoUniformShaderParameterP is a source-file-private implementation class; its destructor is not part of Coin's public ABI.

# The XML C-header conversion changed two output parameters from C++ references
# to their pointer equivalents under C linkage.  The exported C symbol and the
# calling convention are unchanged, and the public C++ inline overloads retain
# the legacy reference source API.  libabigail nevertheless reports the DWARF
# spelling change as an ABI modification.
# Limit these rules to subtype changes so removal of either public symbol
# is still reported. The same restriction applies to the residual reports.

[suppress_function]
  change_kind = function-subtype-change
  symbol_name_regexp = ^cc_xml_doc_get_filter_cb$
  label = C symbol and calling convention are unchanged; the C++ reference API is preserved by an inline bridge over equivalent pointer outputs.

[suppress_function]
  change_kind = function-subtype-change
  symbol_name_regexp = ^cc_xml_doc_write_to_buffer$
  label = C symbol and calling convention are unchanged; the C++ reference API is preserved by an inline bridge over equivalent pointer outputs.

# After the existing type suppressions are applied, libabigail 2.4 still
# counts these two functions as changed even though its own details say that
# size, members, and member functions are unchanged.  Limit the workaround to
# the exact private adapter and template destructor instances seen in the
# v4.0.10-to-master comparison.

[suppress_function]
  change_kind = function-subtype-change
  symbol_name_regexp = ^_ZN19CoinVrmlJsMFHandlerI9SoMFColor9SoSFColorXadL_ZN10CoinVrmlJs7MFColorEEEE11field2jsvalEPvPK7SoFieldPl$
  label = Source-file-private JavaScript adapter; libabigail reports only already-filtered indirect SoField changes.

[suppress_function]
  change_kind = function-subtype-change
  name_regexp = ^CoinVrmlJsMFHandler<SoMFColor, SoSFColor,.*>::field2jsval
  label = Source-file-private JavaScript adapter; match the type-change report by its demangled function name.

[suppress_function]
  change_kind = function-subtype-change
  symbol_name_regexp = ^_ZN6SbListIP6SoNodeED[12]Ev$
  label = Compiler-emitted template destructor; libabigail reports only already-filtered indirect SbList changes with unchanged size and members.

[suppress_function]
  change_kind = function-subtype-change
  name_regexp = ^SbList<SoNode\*>::~SbList
  label = Match only the SbList<SoNode*> destructor type-change report after all underlying changes have already been filtered.
